items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: So I'm the strawboss of the band, and Duke's been my buddy for (inaudible) me different places.

ctx.x: He come out of the Navy to join Hamp's band. I'd like to give you the situation on that, since you brought it up, and I was a go between man and didn't even know it. I'm always a victim of something and don't know why. Duke Garrett's brother in law was the president of the Negro Associated Press in Louisville, Kentucky, married to Duke's sister, and he asked Duke -- before he come out of the Navy, he said, what would you like to do. He said, I'd like to see you go back and finish your schooling. He said, I want…

We closed on Thursday night, and Duke got there before the last show, and I saw -- I said, wait, man. I'll see you when I come out. (Inaudible). Come out of the show, and he tells me he want to meet Hamp. Hamp already know he's coming. I don't know. Duke say, I don't need no money. I got plenty of money. He said, all I need to do is meet Lionel Hampton. I got my card here if you want to use it, whatever you want to do. He's talking to me.
